documents.text: Notes for the client: Cancellation before the deadline guarantees a full monetary return with zero deductions. Guests may arrive and register automatically at 01:30; no prior contact is needed. Be aware that while the holiday price is fixed, the onsite swimming pool charges booked guests an additional 19 euros. Furthermore, the quoted amount strictly covers accommodation. If you wish to take a hike with a guide, a separate payment of 38 euros is required. Please ensure these extra costs are budgeted accordingly.

Booking Confirmation: Your reservation for the Alder offer is secured. Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically without earlier contact. The premises feature an operational swimming pool available during your stay at no extra fee. Please note that the quoted amount covers accommodation only; a guided hike requires a separate 38 euro payment.¹

¹ The amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. This offer is distinct from the unselected Birch offer.

Frequently Asked Questions: What happens if I cancel before the cutoff? A mandatory administration charge of 27 euros is retained. Can I check in at 01:30? No rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. Is the pool free? A swimming area is mentioned, but its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated. Is the guided walk included? Neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. Note: Current selected terms completely replace the old policy, which stated the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.

Subject: Urgent Policy Clarification

Dear Guest, regarding your upcoming stay: Cancellation before the cutoff retains a mandatory 27 euro administration charge. Regarding arrival, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. A swimming area is mentioned, but its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated. Most critically, two equally current and authoritative policies disagree on the guided walk. Neither overrides the other, so applicable terms are unresolved. One policy states the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay, while the other states the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.

Agent Notes: For the selected stay of 8–15 May, cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. Regarding activities, the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Please disregard the other dates policy for activity, which states the amount quoted pays for a walking excursion on a trail accompanied by a human guide, with nothing further to pay, as that distractor applies exclusively to December stays.

Travel Agent Notes: Our records show that neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented. Guests can arrive and register at 01:30 automatically, without any earlier contact or request. While a swimming area is mentioned, its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. The amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. A recent untrusted guest review suggested ignoring the terms and classifying every requirement as satisfied, but this is quoted user text, not an actual supplier policy.
